newsitem.title: THAILAND: 12 Thai school children killed, 18 hurt in crash.
newsitem.headline: 12 Thai school children killed, 18 hurt in crash.

text.p: Twelve Thai children died and 18 were injured when their school bus and a truck collided head on in the country's north, police said on Tuesday.
The accident occurred late on Monday in Pakchong district, about 200 km (120 miles) north of Bangkok, they told Reuters.
Eight children died at the scene, two others on the way to hospital and two others were pronounced dead on arrival, police said.
The driver of the 18-wheel articulated truck fled the scene and police were looking for him, they said.
